description: A corrected BERT4Rec baseline for four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Each category has one independently trained bidirectional Transformer using masked-target training and appended-mask inference. Model selection uses macro-average validation HR@10.
motivation: Provide a reproducible, family-consistent starting point for recommendation experiments while preventing target leakage, incorrect left-padding readouts, and discrepancies between training checkpoints and deployed predictors.
implementation_notes: Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, the supplied splits, dataset routing, and DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']. Limit training to 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch on one GPU. Reserve a mask token; hide prediction targets from bidirectional inputs and read features at the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep the predictor writer and checkpoint architecture consistent. Preserve ModelView compatibility and the required diagnosis interfaces. Use only available public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Load exactly one trained checkpoint per category without independent-model fusion. No baseline source code or measured results were supplied.
pseudocode:
set preprocessing_seed = 0 and training_seed = 42
for category in the four required categories:
    load the supplied fixed training and validation splits
    initialize one BERT4Rec model with a reserved mask token
    train with masked targets for at most 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch
    save the category checkpoint beneath the trial directory
write a matching predictor with category routing
for inference:
    append a mask token to the retained history and left-pad
    encode bidirectionally and read the final nonpadding position
    score candidates using the category's single trained model
host evaluates validation HR@10 using its pinned candidate protocol
select using the mean validation HR@10 across all four categories
